title: Haryana Places, Monuments and Tourism: Quiz

questions.question: At which Kurukshetra spot is Krishna believed to have delivered the Gita to Arjuna?
questions.rationale: Jyotisar, under a banyan tree, is the traditional spot. Brahma Sarovar and Sannihit Sarovar are bathing tanks; Pehowa is an ancestral-rites tirtha.

questions.question: Panipat is nicknamed:
questions.rationale: Panipat is the handloom and textile hub, hence City of Weavers. City of Steel is a nickname of Hisar.

questions.question: Match the Panipat battle with its result: the Second Battle (1556) was won by:
questions.rationale: 1556: Akbar's side under Bairam Khan beat Hemu. Babur won in 1526, Abdali in 1761; Nader Shah's win was at Karnal (1739), not Panipat.

questions.question: The Battle of Karnal in 1739 was fought between:
questions.rationale: Nader Shah of Persia defeated the Mughal emperor Muhammad Shah at Karnal.

questions.question: Hisar was founded in 1354 by:
questions.rationale: Firoz Shah Tughlaq founded Hisar-e-Firoza. Harsha is linked with Thanesar.

questions.question: Which pair is correctly matched?
questions.rationale: Hansi has Asigarh Fort. Agroha goes with Agrasen, Surajpal with Surajkund, and the Gita Mahotsav is held at Kurukshetra.

questions.question: Rakhigarhi, regarded as the largest known Harappan site by ASI estimates, lies in the Ghaggar plain in which area?
questions.rationale: Rakhigarhi is in the Hisar region (Hisar district). Panchkula and Faridabad are not Harappan centres in this sense.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT located in Narnaul?
questions.rationale: Sheikh Chehli's tomb is at Thanesar, Kurukshetra. The other three are Narnaul monuments.

questions.question: Chor Gumbad at Narnaul is actually:
options: A tomb built by Afghan noble Jamal Khan for himself in Firoz Shah's time
questions.rationale: Despite the name it is a double-storeyed tomb, built under Firoz Shah Tughlaq.

questions.question: Pinjore's garden, now renamed, was built under Fidai Khan and is called today:
questions.rationale: It was renamed after Maharaja Yadavindra Singh of Patiala, who restored it. Kabuli Bagh is at Panipat.

questions.question: The Surajkund International Crafts Mela began in 1987 and is held in which district?
questions.rationale: Surajkund lies in Faridabad district, and the mela is held in early February.

questions.question: Which of these is a hill getaway in Panchkula district known for Tikkar Taal?
questions.rationale: Morni Hills have the twin lakes of Tikkar Taal. Sohna is known for hot springs, Tosham for its hill and inscription.

questions.question: Which statement about Haryana tourism is correct?
options: Haryana Tourism Corporation was set up in 1974
Sohna is famous for crafts mela
questions.rationale: HTC dates from 1974 with headquarters in Chandigarh. Sohna is known for sulphur springs and Pinjore is in Panchkula.

questions.question: Agroha, linked by tradition with King Agrasen, lies near which city?
questions.rationale: Agroha mound and the Agroha Dham temple are in Hisar district. Remember Agroha-Agrasen, Hisar-Firoz.
